title: 16 of 55 tickets have no QC verdict at all -- waves 4+ drained with zero shards, including all four Definition-of-Done verification tickets (T50-T53) and all four scope additions (T54-T57)
EDMV4-T55 raised edm-qc-auditor to maxTurns 150 and edm-implementer to 200, but CLAUDE.md's Turn budget parity subsection still instructs contributors that all four verifiers run at 50
EDMV4-T57 AC6 requires every remaining wave7 failure to name an owning ticket; two sites name the literal NEEDS-NEW-TICKET and no follow-on identifier was reserved

SRD Sec.3.4 DoD item 8 unmet -- the 3.3.0 entry documents no GateGuard, hookify, stop-gate, bash-gate, repo-readiness, size classifier, codemap or qc_shard_threshold change despite three new blocking hooks shipping
edm-bash-gate is a sixth new bin/ script that no ticket names as a deliverable and that T50 AC1, T52 AC4 and T53 AC3 all enumerate around
GateGuard's MultiEdit arm shipped although decisions.md D26 conditions its shipping on a re-test that never happened; the ticket pack and the decision ledger contradict each other

The cross-cutting Changelog AC is unassignable by construction -- only T01, T33 and T54 name CHANGELOG.md in Target Components, so no other ticket could satisfy it without a D34 scope violation (T18/T20 mutual-assumption pattern, second instance)
SRD/.codemap.md absent although named in EDMV4-T48 Target Components; every T48 AC binds the instruction rather than the artifact, and all nine are satisfied

All six NOT RUNTIME-VERIFIED (D44) tickets checked against code for their static ACs -- T06, T07, T34, T35, T36, T37 are each genuinely satisfied statically; recorded so verified-clean is distinguishable from never-checked
edm-gateguard is 413 lines against EDMV4-T11 AC1's original 200-400 band; decisions.md D42 raised the ceiling to 500 with rationale recorded at the assertion after a properly escalated refusal
